title: Hydrogen vs. Gasoline Leak and Ignition Test- which is safer?
summary: A 2001 University of Miami experiment ignites a leak from a gasoline fuel line in one car and a leak from a hydrogen connector in another. The hydrogen fire burns out quickly while the gasoline fire consumes its car.
why: HN cites it in hydrogen car debates, with some seeing it as evidence of relative safety and others finding it unconvincing.

quote.text: There are videos out there of what a leak+fire looks like on a hydrogen and gasoline car.
